thread:
Maya (Marketing): quick sync: we need a concise checklist for the dev-focused launch next week (OSS ref app + tutorial series + webinar). main KPIs: repo stars, webinar signups, inbound trial requests. :clipboard:
Ethan (Content): ok. propose the checklist sections: assets, benchmarks, landing, sales ops, community outreach, PR/timing. I'll make a Google checklist and share.
Liam (DevEx): for assets we should have: repo scaffold, 3 markdown tutorials, Dockerfile + k8s manifest, CI for tests. small code samples that copy-paste.
Nia (Community): outreach plan: announce in Discord/Forum + Twitter thread + 2 community partners. recruit one power user to co-present. also set up an issue for community contributors with labels: good-first-issue. :sparkles:
Maya (Marketing): benchmarks: need a single-paragraph narrative + 2 bullets (latency @128, cost per 1k) and an artifact (CSV + commands). Ravi do you own the run?
Ravi (Eng): I'll run baseline on t4g.large + an fp16 quantized path on our staging cluster. deliverables: CSV, small bar chart PNG, and a shell snippet for reproduction. will annotate assumptions.
Sam (Sales Ops): inbound flow: create HubSpot form with hidden field utm_campaign=refapp_spring. webhook to #sales-inbound. create automation: if job_title contains "engineer" -> assign to SDR queue A.
Maya (Marketing): messaging iteration: we need 3 CTAs for the landing page. variant A (technical): "Ship a model-ready app in 20 minutes". variant B (value): "Lower inference costs by 2x with Redwood Optimize". variant C (enterprise): "SLA-backed dedicated inference for teams". we'll A/B test A vs B on blog vs webinar.
Ethan (Content): I'll draft hero copy + 2 tweet variants. sample tweet 1: "New: refapp shows how to go from local prototype to Dedicated inference with Redwood. Workshop + repo -> register: <link>". tweet 2 shorter with a benchmark stat once Ravi has numbers.
Nia (Community): webinar format idea: 30 min demo (Liam + power user), 15 min Q&A, CTA to repo + quickstart. run a rehearsal Wed. can we confirm co-presenter by Tue EOD?
Liam (DevEx): I can demo the deploy + caching steps. will create a short demo script and timebox to 30 minutes.
Ravi (Eng): one ask: legal wants a short footnote for benchmark conditions. LegalBot: please provide required wording template.
LegalBot: Suggested template: "Benchmarks were run on [instance], with sequence length [N], and represent typical internal workloads. Your results may vary."
Maya (Marketing): timeline: Mon - repo + tutorials live draft; Tue - benchmarks + images; Wed - landing page + HubSpot + co-presenter confirmed; Thu - launch post draft + PR review; Fri - webinar dry run; Launch = next Mon (soft).
Sam (Sales Ops): I'll create the HubSpot form by Tue and wire the webhook. also want a hidden field to capture "interested_in": refapp_demo/partner/enterprise.
Ethan (Content): PR notes: embargo until launch Monday 10:00 PT. prepare short media list and a 2-paragraph pitch. who owns media outreach? Maya?
Maya (Marketing): I'll own PR outreach. Ethan, draft pitch. include one benchmark stat and one customer use-case (anonymized).
Nia (Community): Also request: create a short contributor guide (CONTRIBUTING.md) and add license file. reduces friction for OSS contributions.
Liam (DevEx): will add CONTRIBUTING.md and a CODE_OF_CONDUCT.
Maya (Marketing): final check: analytics - add UTM params on all links, enable HubSpot tracking, enable repo traffic alerts. Ravi: attach CSV and a brief README note pointing to reproduction.
Ravi (Eng): will push artifacts to /artifacts/perf/refapp_bench.csv and include reproduction steps in README.
Maya (Marketing): sounds good. owners: Ethan (copy + PR pitch), Liam (repo + demos), Ravi (benchmarks + artifacts), Nia (community + co-presenter), Sam (HubSpot + routing), Maya (PR outreach + launch). We'll reconvene in this thread tomorrow morning. :rocket:
